reason: The answer letter readout (letter_readout "answer") read letter probabilities at the first single-letter token of the response's logprobs. Liquid AI's API returns logprobs for the reasoning tokens too, so every LFM2.5 decision read a letter from the reasoning text (off: the 16-token budget ended inside the reasoning, no answer at all; on: 88 of 101 sampled decisions read a different letter than the model answered). For Qwen3.8 Flash (off) via OpenRouter/Alibaba, 145 of 930 decisions read the lowercase c of a "choice" key split into c/ho/ice. The runner now reads the last uppercase single-letter token that ends the reply and counts a mismatch with the reply's letter as invalid (74d74c7). Audit of the other answer-readout setups: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (off, on) and GLM-5.3 (on) via Fireworks and Qwen3.8-27B via Cerebras read the reply's letter in every sampled decision.

change: Qwen3.8-27B (off) matches played on our vLLM server voided and replayed from scratch with the same seeds (letter readout fix)
reason: The answer letter readout found the letter's logprobs entry only when the tokens after it spelled the end of the reply. vLLM (Qwen3.8-27B (off), from 2026-10-19 22:26 UTC) lists the end-of-sequence token <|im_end|> after the letter although it is not in the reply, so no entry was found and every decision (1,572) fell back to the reply's letter, sampled at temperature 1 (probability_source choice_only), instead of the argmax of the letter probabilities the protocol plays. The runner now leaves out trailing special tokens (afc7b41). Audit of every setup in Leagues 1 and 2 by probability_source: no other setup that should give probabilities has choice_only decisions (Claude, GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini via subscriptions are choice only by design; League 1's decision services all report decision probabilities; Gemma 4 31B, LFM2.5-24B-A2B and Qwen3.8-27B (on) read logprobs).
